label: Episode 16
logline: When hired thugs attack Juliana's medicinal garden, Alexander unleashes his combat training to effortlessly overpower them, extracting a shocking confession that unmasks Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 15's cliffhanger where Alexander confronted the three thugs in the moonlit garden while Juliana huddled injured on the ground.

[00:06.40-00:09.50] CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the Thug with Cap gripping his weapon with both hands and roaring into the night air.
[00:06.40-00:08.80] THUG WITH CAP (Furious, Shouting): "I said, move!"
[00:09.50-00:11.20] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander remaining completely motionless, his jaw clenched in stoic calm.
[00:11.20-00:13.10] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana kneeling in the mud against the ruined planter, clutching her bandaged hands to her chest in trembling fear.
[00:11.20-00:12.70] JULIANA (Frightened, Whispering): "Alexander..."

[00:14.40-00:15.50] THUG WITH CAP (Roaring): "Aaargh!"
[00:14.40-00:16.80] ACTION: The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
[00:15.80-00:16.50] SOUND: Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
[00:16.80-00:19.50] CAMERA: Close-up of the Thug with Cap staring in wide-eyed terror as Alexander grips the bar and wrenches it away effortlessly.
[00:19.20-00:21.80] ACTION: Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
[00:19.80-00:21.20] SOUND: Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
[00:21.80-00:23.00] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching in breathless astonishment.
[00:23.00-00:25.80] CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as the Bald Thug charges in with a shout, only for Alexander to pivot and seize him by the neck, hurling him across the garden path.
[00:23.00-00:23.80] BALD THUG (Yelling): "Aaargh!"
[00:24.20-00:25.50] SOUND: Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
[00:25.80-00:28.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of the Third Thug backing away nervously, raising a blunt rod with trembling arms before lunging.
[00:25.80-00:27.10] THIRD THUG (Desperate, Shouting): "Stay back!"
[00:26.50-00:28.50] ACTION: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
[00:27.00-00:28.20] SOUND: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
[00:28.50-00:31.00] CAMERA: Wide cinematic shot under the full moon. Alexander towers over the three writhing thugs groaning in the mud as Juliana looks up from her knees.
[00:31.00-00:34.50] CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up at Alexander, tears glistening on her mud-splattered cheeks in profound relief.
[00:32.00-00:33.80] JULIANA (Breathless, Overwhelmed): "Alexander..."
[00:34.50-00:38.05] CAMERA: Medium shot over Juliana's shoulder as Alexander turns his gaze toward her, his stern demeanor softening with concern.
[00:36.20-00:37.80] ALEXANDER (Gentle, Concerned): "Are you hurt?"

CLIP: episode 16, 1 segment(s), 39s
[00:38.20-00:40.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's trembling, soil-stained hands wrapped in blood-soaked bandages.
[00:38.20-00:40.00] JULIANA (Fragile, Pain-filled): "Only my hands."
[00:40.80-00:44.20] CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander suddenly wheels around, strides to the groaning Thug with Cap, and yanks him straight off the ground by his coat collar with one arm.
[00:41.20-00:44.00] ACTION: Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.
[00:42.50-00:44.00] ALEXANDER (Demanding, Threatening): "Who sent you?"
[00:44.20-00:46.20] CAMERA: Close-up of the Thug with Cap gagging under Alexander's iron fist.
[00:44.20-00:45.30] THUG WITH CAP (Choking, Defiant): "No one!"
[00:46.20-00:48.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his eyes darkening with lethal fury.
[00:46.30-00:47.40] ALEXANDER (Cold, Ominous): "Wrong answer."
[00:48.00-00:50.00] ACTION: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.
[00:48.80-00:49.60] ALEXANDER (Roaring): "Who?!"
[00:49.80-00:52.80] CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the terrified thug gasping for air, his eyes bulging.
[00:49.80-00:52.20] THUG WITH CAP (Screaming, Panicked): "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"
[00:52.80-00:55.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana on the ground, reeling in devastated disbelief as the betrayal hits her.
[00:53.20-00:54.40] JULIANA (Shaken, Heartbroken): "Gerald..."
[00:55.20-00:59.00] CAMERA: Medium wide shot as Alexander releases the thug, sending him tumbling into the ruined flowerbeds.
[00:55.50-00:58.50] ACTION: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.
[00:56.00-00:58.20] THUG WITH CAP (Shouting, Retreating): "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"

[01:00.00-01:03.00] ACTION: Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
[01:03.00-01:06.50] CAMERA: Medium shot as Juliana gingerly rises to her feet, stepping toward Alexander with deep awe and wonder in her eyes.
[01:04.20-01:06.20] JULIANA (Soft, Astounded): "You knew exactly what to do."

[01:11.00-01:14.00] ALEXANDER (Somber, Heavy-Hearted): "A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget."
[01:14.20-01:16.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana softening with deep empathy as her eyes drop to his bleeding knuckle.
[01:14.80-01:15.80] JULIANA (Tender, Concerned): "Are you hurt?"
[01:16.00-01:17.05] ACTION: Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.
[01:16.80-01:17.05] CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana standing face-to-face in the moonlit garden, framed against the dark night.
